abstract: During the years of the Bretton Woods system, Milton Friedman and Harry Johnson, respectively, authored two of the most influential articles on exchange‐rate systems. Friedman's article, “The Case for Flexible Exchange Rates,” was published in 1953. Johnson's article, published 16 years later, carried the almost identical title—“The Case for Flexible Exchange Rates, 1969.” While both articles achieved classic status in the 1970s and the 1980s, Johnson's essay appears to have surpassed Friedman's essay in stature in the view of some economists. This paper provides a comparison of the arguments in favor of flexible rates and against fixed rates presented by Friedman and Johnson. I conclude that Friedman's essay presaged all of the major arguments made in Johnson's essay while excluding several major misses made by Johnson. Nevertheless, there were pragmatic reasons why Johnson's essay became more influential.
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: The Case for Flexible Exchange Rates in 1953 and 1969: Friedman versus Johnson
title_zh: 1953年与1969年支持浮动汇率的理由：弗里德曼与约翰逊之比较

abstract: Under the U.S. personal bankruptcy law, exempt assets are not liquidated following bankruptcy. Entrepreneurs can undo such a protection by posting collateral. We provide a complete characterization of the interplay between asset exemption from liquidation upon default and adverse selection in a competitive credit market. Severe adverse selection induces separation, with safer entrepreneurs choosing loan contracts characterized by high collateral requirements, lower cost of credit, and credit rationing for wealth‐constraints applicants. Irrespective of adverse selection, poor safe entrepreneurs pool as they face too much rationing, otherwise. Higher exemption makes collateral more informative. Evidence from the Survey of Small Business Finances survey supports our theory.
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Asset Exemption in Bankruptcy, Access to and Cost of Credit
title_zh: 破产中的资产豁免、信贷获取与信贷成本

abstract: We revisit the reversal puzzle: a counterintuitive contraction of inflation in response to an interest rate peg. We show that its occurrence is intimately related to the degree of agents' anticipation. If agents perfectly anticipate the peg, reversals occur depending on the duration of the peg. If they do not anticipate the peg, reversals are absent. In the case of imperfect anticipation, implemented by a Markov‐switching framework, we measure the degree of anticipation by the frequency of the peg regime. Even if the frequency of the peg takes on a value much larger than empirically plausible, the reversal puzzle is absent.
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Interest Rate Pegs and the Reversal Puzzle: On the Role of Anticipation
title_zh: 利率钉住与逆转之谜：预期的作用

abstract: We show that undercapitalized banks with large holdings of government bonds subject to sovereign default risk lead to a new crowding‐out channel: deficit‐financed fiscal stimuli lead to higher bond yields, triggering capital losses for the banks. Banks then cut back loans, which reduces fiscal multipliers. Crowding out increases for longer maturity bonds and higher sovereign default risk. We estimate a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model with financial frictions for Spain and find strong support for these results. The cumulative multiplier decreases substantially with the size of the stimulus, and with the amount of time between the announcement and implementation of the stimulus.
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Financial Fragility and the Fiscal Multiplier
title_zh: 金融脆弱性与财政乘数

abstract: The IMF recently updated its institutional view on capital flow management and macroprudential policies for emerging markets (EMs). The framework advocates a variety of prudential tools to deal with generally complex and heterogeneous financial flows. This paper provides a normative justification for this integrated approach when investors have access to multiple assets. As is well‐known, the EM overborrows in international markets, which justifies to actively manage international capital flows. However, as a novel result, this paper also advocates complementary domestic macroprudential policies: reallocating domestic resources toward internationally constrained borrowers improves welfare because it shifts funds to households with a higher marginal propensity to consume. This result emerges independent of any domestic externality. A numerical exercise further shows that partial regulation can increase the severity of a recession relative to no regulation.
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Macroprudential Policy Interlinkages
title_zh: 宏观审慎政策的相互关联

abstract: The impact of Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) is analyzed in a closed‐economy model with monopolistic competition in banking and where CBDC is an imperfect substitute with bank deposits. The design of CBDC is characterized by its interest rate, its substitutability with bank deposits, and its relative liquidity. We examine how interest‐bearing CBDC would affect the banking sector, public finance, GDP, and welfare. Welfare may improve through three channels: seigniorage; a lower opportunity cost of money; and a redistribution away from bank owners. In our numerical analysis, we find a maximum welfare improvement of almost 50 bps in consumption terms.
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: CBDC as Imperfect Substitute to Bank Deposits: A Macroeconomic Perspective
title_zh: CBDC作为银行存款的不完全替代：宏观经济视角

abstract: While considerable attention is devoted to the effects of various market and policy factors on carbon returns, the role of investor risk aversion remains underexplored. This paper examines whether the effect of investor risk aversion (RA) on European Union Allowance (EUA) returns varies across market conditions using a quantile regression approach and daily data from 2 January 2008, to 24 June 2024. The results show that RA negatively affects EUA returns under bearish market conditions but positively affects EUA returns under extreme bullish market conditions, with stronger effects observed during extreme market conditions. Further analysis shows that the Paris Agreement and the COVID-19 pandemic strengthen the effect of RA on EUA returns, while public attention to climate change amplifies this effect during extreme downturns. Historical return information mitigates the effect of RA on EUA returns. These findings underscore the importance of investor risk aversion for carbon returns and contribute to a better understanding of how behavioural factors affect carbon markets.
title: Risk aversion and carbon price returns: evidence from market extremes
title_zh: 风险厌恶与碳价格回报：来自市场极端的证据

abstract: Extreme climate events destroy capital, amplify financial frictions, and occur with probabilities that depend endogenously on emissions. We study these interactions in a New Keynesian environmental DSGE model with green and brown firms, disaster risk, bank balance-sheet frictions, and resilience capital. Resilience investment mitigates output losses and stabilizes banks by substituting for damaged private capital. When recovery is concentrated in brown production, resilience investment can generate an emissions rebound. A carbon tax contains this rebound and raises welfare, whereas green quantitative easing mainly reallocates credit and provides limited aggregate stabilization. Effective resilience policy therefore requires coordination across adaptation, mitigation, and financial stability.
abstract_zh: 极端气候事件会摧毁资本、放大金融摩擦，且其发生概率内生于排放水平。我们在一个包含绿色企业与棕色企业、灾害风险、银行资产负债表摩擦以及韧性资本的新凯恩斯环境DSGE模型中研究这些相互作用。韧性投资通过替代受损的私人资本，减轻产出损失并稳定银行。当复苏集中于棕色生产时，韧性投资可能引发排放反弹。碳税能够遏制这种反弹并提高福利，而绿色量化宽松主要重新配置信贷，提供的总量稳定作用有限。因此，有效的韧性政策需要在适应、减缓与金融稳定之间进行协调。
china_relevance_reason: journal or topic scope is China economy
title: Navigating climate shocks: The macroeconomic and financial stabilizing role of government-led resilience investments
title_zh: 应对气候冲击：政府主导的韧性投资的宏观经济与金融稳定作用

abstract: Spatial heterogeneity in crime suggests that location is a key choice variable in criminal behavior and police allocation. To capture this, we develop a topological model in which criminals and the police interact strategically across space. The key departure from the existing literature is that distance matters: the coverage radius of a police unit generates spatial spillovers, so a location can receive protection from nearby patrols. This is in sharp contrast with discrete spatial models, where each discrete partition is isolated from its surroundings, biasing the equilibrium police allocation. We analytically characterize this bias and, more generally, demonstrate how spillovers affect the equilibrium police allocation. In particular, as spillovers increase: (i) more (fewer) units are allocated at local maxima (minima) of crime; (ii) the location where units are more concentrated shifts toward the steepest side of the crime distribution; and (iii) the entropy of the police spatial density decreases. Jointly, our results point to the essential role of spatial spillovers in the equilibrium determination of crime and police allocation.
abstract_zh: 犯罪的空间异质性表明，地点是犯罪行为与警力配置中的关键选择变量。为刻画这一点，我们构建了一个拓扑模型，其中犯罪分子与警察在空间上策略性互动。与现有文献的关键区别在于距离至关重要：警察单位的覆盖半径会产生空间溢出效应，因此一个地点可以从附近巡逻中获得保护。这与离散空间模型形成鲜明对比，在离散空间模型中，每个离散分区与其周围环境相互隔离，从而使均衡警力配置产生偏误。我们解析地刻画了这种偏误，并更一般地证明了溢出效应如何影响均衡警力配置。特别地，随着溢出效应增强：(i) 更多（更少）单位被配置在犯罪的局部极大值（极小值）处；(ii) 单位更为集中的地点向犯罪分布最陡峭的一侧转移；(iii) 警察空间密度的熵下降。综合来看，我们的结果指向空间溢出效应在犯罪与警力配置的均衡决定中的根本作用。
title: Spatial Protection Spillovers and the Equilibrium of Crime and Policing
title_zh: 空间保护溢出与犯罪和警务的均衡

abstract: Using the universe of Texas births from 1976–1997, matched to marriage records through 2019, we provide the first U.S. evidence on how sibling sex composition affects marriage outcomes. First-born individuals with a same-sex younger sibling are more likely to marry, and to marry earlier, consistent with evidence from other settings. The scale and diversity of our setting further let us examine how these effects differ across race and ethnicity. We find they are concentrated among White individuals and in wealthier counties, with Hispanic women also responding in higher-income areas.
abstract_zh: 利用1976至1997年间得克萨斯州全部出生人口数据，并将其与截至2019年的婚姻记录相匹配，我们首次提供了美国关于兄弟姐妹性别构成如何影响婚姻结果的证据。有同性较年幼弟妹的长子女更有可能结婚，且结婚更早，这与其他背景下的证据一致。我们研究环境的规模和多样性还使我们得以考察这些效应在种族和族裔之间的差异。我们发现，这些效应集中于白人个体以及较富裕的县，而西班牙裔女性在高收入地区也表现出相应反应。
title: Sibling sex composition, race, and marriage in the United States
title_zh: 美国兄弟姐妹性别构成、种族与婚姻

abstract: We study the impact of old-age assistance on mortality using the 1909 introduction of public pensions in the United Kingdom as a quasi-natural experiment. Estimating difference-in-differences and an event-time design, we show that elderly mortality in England and Wales declined with the pension introduction. The estimated decline is economically relevant, stronger in counties with more pensioners, and driven by fewer deaths from both infectious and non-infectious diseases. Analyzing full-count individual-level census data points to a reduction in residential crowding and retirement, especially from occupations associated with high mortality rates, as likely channels.
abstract_zh: 我们以英国1909年引入公共养老金作为准自然实验，研究老年援助对死亡率的影响。通过估计双重差分和事件时间设计，我们表明英格兰和威尔士的老年人死亡率随着养老金的引入而下降。估计的下降在经济上具有相关性，在养老金领取者更多的郡更为显著，并且是由传染病和非传染病死亡人数减少所驱动。分析全计数个体层面的人口普查数据表明，居住拥挤程度下降以及退休——尤其是从与高死亡率相关的职业中退出——可能是其渠道。
title: Can Pensions Save Lives? Evidence from the Introduction of Old-Age Assistance in the United Kingdom
title_zh: 养老金能拯救生命吗？来自英国老年援助制度引入的证据

abstract: We investigate how macro-level factors—economic, social, environmental, and institutional—shape the levelized cost of electricity (LCOE) for onshore wind energy in Europe over time, while accounting for spatial dependence. Using a balanced annual panel of 10 OECD European countries from 2011 to 2023 , we estimate a Spatial Durbin Model with two-way fixed effects, which receives the strongest overall support among the non-spatial and spatial models considered. By decomposing total impacts into direct and indirect impacts, we find that macro-level factors are associated with LCOE through domestic and spatial spillover channels. Stronger economic and institutional performance is associated with lower LCOE through both channels, with spatial spillovers larger than the corresponding direct impacts. Higher emission intensity is associated with higher LCOE through both channels, whereas higher human development is associated with higher LCOE primarily through the domestic channel. Among the control variables, the association with LCOE is negative for cumulative onshore wind electricity generation and cumulative wind energy patents, but positive for renewable electricity generation share. Overall, our findings highlight cross-country spatial dependence and suggest that onshore wind energy cost-reduction policies in Europe should consider regional coordination rather than focusing exclusively on national conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们考察宏观经济、社会、环境与制度等宏观层面因素如何在考虑空间依赖性的情况下，随时间推移影响欧洲陆上风能的平准化度电成本（LCOE）。我们使用2011年至2023年10个OECD欧洲国家的平衡年度面板数据，估计了一个双向固定效应的空间杜宾模型；在所考虑的非空间与空间模型中，该模型获得总体最强支持。通过将总影响分解为直接影响与间接影响，我们发现宏观层面因素通过国内渠道与空间溢出渠道与LCOE相关。更强的经济与制度表现通过两种渠道均与更低的LCOE相关，且空间溢出大于相应的直接影响。更高的排放强度通过两种渠道均与更高的LCOE相关，而更高的人类发展水平主要通过国内渠道与更高的LCOE相关。在控制变量中，累计陆上风电发电量与累计风能专利与LCOE的关联为负，而可再生电力发电占比与LCOE的关联为正。总体而言，我们的发现凸显了跨国空间依赖性，并表明欧洲陆上风能降本政策应考虑区域协调，而非仅聚焦于各国自身条件。
title: Economic, social, environmental, and institutional factors shaping onshore wind LCOE in Europe: Evidence from spatial panel models
title_zh: 塑造欧洲陆上风电平准化度电成本的经济、社会、环境与制度因素：来自空间面板模型的证据

abstract: At high penetration levels, variable renewable energy (VRE) reshapes price formation in wholesale electricity markets by increasing both oversupply and scarcity. While the fundamental mechanisms underlying extreme prices are well documented, the role of bidding behavior in amplifying price spikes under scarcity remains underexplored. This paper develops an empirical framework to characterize how aggregate bidding patterns respond to system scarcity, as proxied by residual load, and embeds the resulting behavioral rules in an agent-based market simulation to assess their implications under a future energy-transition scenario. The framework is applied to the Belgian, Dutch, and German day-ahead markets, testing it across systems with different VRE penetration levels. The results show that aggregate supply curves become significantly steeper with residual load, while bidding volumes shift toward upper price segments. In the 2035 simulation, scarcity-induced strategic bidding increases the annual average price in Germany by 15.49% (7.38 EUR/MWh) relative to marginal-cost bidding, while the peak price rises from 153 to 561 EUR/MWh (+268%), with effects concentrated in a small share of scarcity hours. These results suggest that extreme price formation cannot be understood from fundamental supply conditions alone. As VRE penetration increases and the dispatchable margin becomes more constrained, scarcity-related bidding behavior can substantially amplify price extremes. Navigating these risks requires market monitoring that distinguishes efficient scarcity rents from strategic conduct, alongside careful policy design to manage the underlying structural exposure to scarcity—primarily sufficient cross-border interconnection and dispatchable capacity—without dampening the price signals needed for long-term adequacy.
abstract_zh: 在高渗透率水平下，可变可再生能源（VRE）通过同时加剧过剩与稀缺，重塑了批发电力市场的价格形成。尽管极端价格背后的基本机制已有充分文献记载，但投标行为在稀缺条件下放大价格尖峰的作用仍未被充分探讨。本文构建了一个实证框架，用以刻画总体投标模式如何响应以剩余负荷为代理变量的系统稀缺性，并将由此得到的行为规则嵌入基于主体的市场模拟中，以评估其在未来能源转型情景下的影响。该框架被应用于比利时、荷兰和德国日前市场，并在具有不同VRE渗透率的系统中进行检验。结果表明，总体供给曲线随剩余负荷显著变陡，同时投标量向高价段转移。在2035年模拟中，相对于边际成本投标，稀缺诱发的策略性投标使德国年度平均价格提高15.49%（7.38欧元/兆瓦时），而峰值价格从153欧元/兆瓦时升至561欧元/兆瓦时（+268%），其影响集中在少数稀缺时段。这些结果表明，极端价格形成不能仅从基本供给条件来理解。随着VRE渗透率提高且可调度裕度变得更加受限，与稀缺相关的投标行为可能大幅放大价格极端值。应对这些风险需要市场监测，以区分有效率的稀缺租金与策略性行为，同时需要审慎的政策设计来管理对稀缺性的 underlying 结构性暴露——主要是充足的跨境互联和可调度容量——而不抑制长期充裕性所需的价格信号。
title: High to low: Price formation and bid placement at the extremes
title_zh: 从高到低：极端情况下的价格形成与投标定价

abstract: Economic downturns often come along with a reduction of apprenticeship training by firms, hereby threatening economies with a lack of skilled labour in the mid- and long-run. Against this background, the German government has implemented an apprenticeship subsidy for small and medium sized companies in the summer of 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic. In brief, companies that maintained their number of new apprenticeships at the average level of the past three years could receive €2000 for each apprenticeship starting in the autumn of 2020. We exploit eligibility for the subsidy due to firm size and compare eligible and non-eligible firms in an intent-to-treat difference-in-differences (DiD) design. The estimates show no impact on the number of new apprenticeships but a moderate effect on the probability to maintain the training level at the level of the past three years. This suggests that firms that were at the margin of maintaining the level without the subsidy have hired a small number of additional apprentices to receive the subsidy. This mirrors the incentive structure of the subsidy, as firms at the margin have received a large amount of money for a small number of additional apprenticeships. These results are robust to a wide range of sensitivity and robustness checks, including linear and non-linear DiD estimation, tests for diverging trends, placebo tests with placebo outcomes as well as checks for panel attrition. These results add to the scarce literature on the impact of training subsidies in general and their impact during economic crises in particular.
abstract_zh: 经济衰退往往伴随着企业学徒培训的减少，从而在中长期内使经济体面临熟练劳动力短缺的威胁。在此背景下，德国政府在2020年夏季新冠疫情期间针对中小企业实施了学徒补贴政策。简言之，那些将新学徒数量维持在过去三年平均水平的公司，可为2020年秋季开始的每份学徒岗位获得2000欧元补贴。我们利用企业规模所决定的补贴资格，在意向性治疗（intent-to-treat）的双重差分（DiD）设计中对符合条件与不符合条件的企业进行比较。估计结果显示，补贴对新学徒数量没有影响，但对将培训水平维持在过去三年水平上的概率具有中等程度的影响。这表明，那些在没有补贴时处于维持该水平边缘的企业，额外雇佣了少量学徒以获得补贴。这反映了该补贴的激励结构，因为处于边缘的企业为少量额外学徒获得了大量资金。这些结果在广泛的敏感性和稳健性检验下均保持稳健，包括线性与非线性DiD估计、趋势发散检验、以安慰剂结果为对象的安慰剂检验以及面板 attrition 检验。这些结果补充了关于培训补贴总体影响、尤其是其在经济危机期间影响的稀缺文献。
title: Efficient stabilizer or deadweight effect? The impact of subsidies for apprenticeship training during an economic downturn
title_zh: 高效稳定器还是负担效应？经济衰退期间学徒培训补贴的影响

abstract: This study evaluates how China's price-index insurance policy affects natural rubber land transitions in Hainan Province. We utilize satellite imagery to classify natural rubber land based on its unique phenological characteristics, specifically the leaf-off and refoliation signals. We then conduct a village-level analysis using a 2018–2021 panel of 719 villages to study the impact of insurance coverage on these land transitions. To establish causality, an instrumental variable (IV) strategy is introduced. Our results indicate that a 1% rise in the insured share causes a 0.055–0.237% increase in next-year rubber acreage. At the grower level, higher premiums and rubber prices reduce insurance take-up, whereas subsidies increase participation. Policy simulations show that a 1% increase in total subsidy expenditure raises insured acreage by approximately 0.29%, translating into a 0.016–0.069% increase in rubber acreage. The estimated carbon benefits exceed fiscal costs when valued using the social cost of carbon, although not at prevailing domestic carbon-market prices. Future climate projections further indicate the need for dynamic subsidy adjustments to sustain insurance participation under increasing climate risk.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了中国价格指数保险政策如何影响海南省天然橡胶的土地流转。我们利用卫星影像，依据天然橡胶独特的物候特征，特别是落叶与重新展叶信号，对天然橡胶土地进行分类。随后，我们使用2018—2021年719个村庄的面板数据进行村级分析，以研究保险覆盖对这些土地流转的影响。为建立因果关系，引入了工具变量（IV）策略。结果表明，参保份额每提高1%，下一年橡胶种植面积增加0.055%—0.237%。在种植者层面，较高的保费和橡胶价格会降低保险参与率，而补贴则提高参与率。政策模拟显示，总补贴支出每增加1%，参保面积约增加0.29%，进而使橡胶种植面积增加0.016%—0.069%。按碳的社会成本估值时，估计的碳收益超过财政成本，但按现行国内碳市场价格估值时则并非如此。未来气候预测进一步表明，需要动态调整补贴，以在气候风险上升的情况下维持保险参与。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Insurance and land-use permanence in natural rubber: Implications for land transitions and carbon dynamics from Hainan, China
title_zh: 保险与天然橡胶土地利用的永久性：来自中国海南对土地转型与碳动态的启示

abstract: Industrial policy in Africa has regained prominence, yet many registered manufacturing investments do not progress to production. This study examines the spatial patterning and correlates of implementation using a field-verified geospatial census of 2277 manufacturing projects in Shaggar City, Ethiopia. Projects were classified into five ordered implementation categories: Not Implemented, Abandoned, Under Construction, Construction Completed, and Operational. Ordered logistic regression was used to examine associations with network distance from Addis Ababa's central business district (CBD), firm size, industrial subsector, and distance to former town centers. In the primary specification, greater distance from the CBD was negatively associated in the primary ordinal specification with lower cumulative odds of being in a higher implementation category (OR = 0.921, 95% CI: 0.901–0.942, p < 0.001). The distance association was nonlinear in supplementary specifications, although its precise form varied across model formulations. Residual diagnostics, however, indicated substantial spatial autocorrelation across all four cumulative thresholds (Moran's I, p < 0.001), limiting the extent to which conventional model-based uncertainty can be interpreted as spatially independent inference. Distance to former town centers showed evidence of stage-specific association, concentrated at earlier implementation transitions. Firm size was also associated with implementation status in the primary ordinal model, with large projects having lower cumulative odds than small projects; this association weakened after adjustment for project timing and was directionally reversed in a binary multilevel sensitivity model. The latter model accounted for sub-city clustering but produced a non-positive-definite Hessian and is therefore treated as indicative rather than confirmatory. Missing firm-size information was spatially patterned, with missing records more common near the metropolitan core and among projects with higher operational rates. These findings show that manufacturing implementation is a spatially structured, multi-stage process and that observed associations depend on how implementation stage, project timing, missing information, and spatial dependence are handled. The study highlights the value of field-verified project-level data for distinguishing registered investment from actual implementation and for identifying where different stages of the implementation process may require closer monitoring and support.
abstract_zh: 非洲的产业政策重新受到重视，但许多已登记制造业投资并未推进到生产阶段。本研究利用对埃塞俄比亚沙加尔市2277个制造业项目进行实地核验的地理空间普查，考察了实施的空间格局及其相关因素。项目被划分为五个有序实施类别：未实施、已废弃、在建、建设完成和运营。采用有序逻辑回归考察其与距亚的斯亚贝巴中央商务区（CBD）的网络距离、企业规模、工业子行业以及距前城镇中心距离之间的关联。在主设定中，在主要有序设定下，距CBD越远与处于更高实施类别的累积几率越低呈负相关（OR = 0.921，95% CI：0.901–0.942，p < 0.001）。在补充设定中，距离关联呈非线性，尽管其具体形式因模型设定而异。然而，残差诊断表明，在所有四个累积阈值上均存在显著空间自相关（Moran's I，p < 0.001），这限制了将传统基于模型的不确定性解释为空间独立推断的程度。距前城镇中心的距离显示出阶段特异性关联的证据，主要集中在较早的实施转换阶段。在主要有序模型中，企业规模也与实施状态相关，大型项目比小型项目具有更低的累积几率；在调整项目时间后，这一关联减弱，并在二元多层敏感性模型中方向反转。后一模型考虑了子城市聚类，但产生了非正定Hessian矩阵，因此被视为指示性而非确证性结果。缺失的企业规模信息具有空间模式，缺失记录在大都市核心附近以及运营率较高的项目中更为常见。这些发现表明，制造业实施是一个空间结构化的多阶段过程，且观察到的关联取决于如何处理实施阶段、项目时间、缺失信息和空间依赖。本研究凸显了实地核验的项目层面数据在区分已登记投资与实际实施，以及识别实施过程不同阶段可能需要在哪些方面加强监测和支持方面的价值。
title: Scale and space in industrial policy implementation: Geospatial evidence from urban Ethiopia
title_zh: 产业政策实施的规模与空间：来自埃塞俄比亚城市的地理空间证据

abstract: This study estimates the crop‐specific area elasticities for 10 countries or regions using Bayesian methods to ensure that the results are consistent with the expectations suggested by economic theory and applied economics. Important outcomes are as follows. First, a rich set of elasticities and first derivatives are provided that go far beyond any recently published paper to support applied economic analysis of market commodity supplies and changing land use of key crop‐producing countries and regions. Second, double‐cropping can induce unexpected area responses, such as positive cross‐effects. Third, the expected returns of the major crops in a country, such as corn in the United States and soybeans in Brazil, potentially lead to a greater increase in the total crop area than other crops. Fourth, total land constraints reduce parameter uncertainty but highlight potential differences between reallocating land versus cropland expansion and contraction.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用贝叶斯方法估算了10个国家或地区的作物特定面积弹性，以确保结果与经济理论和应用经济学的预期相一致。主要结论如下。第一，本文提供了一套丰富的弹性和一阶导数，远超近期发表的任何论文，可支持对主要作物生产国家和地区的市场商品供给及土地利用变化的应⽤经济分析。第二，复种可能引发意外的面积反应，例如正向交叉效应。第三，一国主要作物的预期收益，如美国的玉米和巴西的大豆，可能比其他作物带来更大的总作物面积增长。第四，总土地约束降低了参数不确定性，但凸显了土地重新配置与耕地扩张和收缩之间的潜在差异。
title: Estimation of Global Crop Area Elasticities: A Bayesian Approach
title_zh: 全球作物面积弹性的估计：贝叶斯方法

abstract: In recent years, health and nutrition policies that spur behavioral change through the provision of information have risen in popularity, in part due to their relatively lower implementation costs. This study investigates the heterogeneous impact of the Nutrition Facts Panel (NFP) update, specifically focusing on the disclosure of added sugars on carbonated soft drink (CSD) consumption in the United States. Using NielsenIQ household panel data covering 9989 U.S. households between 2017 and 2020, we first estimate a difference-in-differences framework before and after label implementation as a baseline analysis. We find that the policy led to significant reductions in CSD purchases on average. We then use causal forest methods to examine heterogeneous treatment effects and show that the response varies systematically with household demographic and attitudinal characteristics. Lower-income and less-educated consumers exhibited stronger reductions, while higher-income, health-conscious households, who already prioritized healthier attributes, were less influenced. Consumers’ attitudes towards different food attributes also play a critical role. Scenario analyses suggest that predicted responsiveness to the disclosure varies across health-conscious preference dimensions, with modest associations among the least responsive households and more mixed patterns among high-consumption households. These findings underscore the importance of considering consumer heterogeneity in policy design and suggest that labeling policies could be complemented by targeted interventions to maximize their effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 近年来，通过提供信息以促进行为改变的健康与营养政策日益流行，部分原因在于其相对较低的实施成本。本研究考察营养事实标签（NFP）更新所带来的异质性影响，特别关注添加糖披露对美国碳酸软饮料（CSD）消费的作用。我们使用涵盖2017年至2020年间9989个美国家庭的NielsenIQ家庭面板数据，首先估计标签实施前后的双重差分框架作为基准分析。我们发现，该政策平均而言导致CSD购买显著减少。随后，我们使用因果森林方法考察异质性处理效应，并表明其反应会随家庭人口统计特征和态度特征而系统性变化。低收入和受教育程度较低的消费者表现出更强的减少，而已经优先考虑更健康属性的高收入、健康意识较强的家庭受到的影响较小。消费者对不同食品属性的态度也起着关键作用。情景分析表明，对披露的预测反应在不同健康意识偏好维度上存在差异，在反应最弱的家庭中关联较为温和，而在高消费家庭中则呈现更为混合的模式。这些发现凸显了在政策设计中考虑消费者异质性的重要性，并表明标签政策可以通过有针对性的干预措施加以补充，以最大化其有效性。
title: Heterogeneous consumer responses to added sugar disclosures: Evidence from the U.S. nutrition facts panel update
title_zh: 消费者对添加糖披露的异质性反应：来自美国营养成分表更新的证据

abstract: We consider GLS and OLS estimation in a linear regression model with serially correlated errors, and we provide the following contributions. First, we clarify when OLS is consistent or not. Second, we give sufficient conditions such that GLS is valid without the assumption of exogenous regressors (uncorrelated with past innovations). Third, we devise a feasible GLS procedure valid whether or not the regressors are exogenous, and which achieves a MSE close to that of the correctly specified infeasible GLS. Fourth, we derive the asymptotic distribution of this feasible GLS estimate: with exogenous regressors, the limit distribution is the same as that of the infeasible GLS estimator. However, with non-exogenous regressors, an additional term is present in the asymptotic variance. We provide a variance estimator, free of tuning parameters, which delivers confidence intervals with asymptotically correct coverage in both cases. We also illustrate how GLS can be more robust than OLS when the regressors are exogenous, even when GLS is based on an incorrect correction. The main assumptions are: a) the regressors are pre-determined (uncorrelated with future innovations); b) the errors are stationary thereby admitting a Wold representation in terms of some unpredictable innovations; c) the moving-average representation of the errors is invertible and implies a short-memory process. We also briefly address issues related to heteroskedastic errors.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑在误差项存在序列相关的线性回归模型中的GLS和OLS估计，并提供以下贡献。第一，我们阐明OLS何时一致或不一致。第二，我们给出充分条件，使得GLS在无需外生回归元（与过去新息不相关）假设的情况下仍然有效。第三，我们设计一种可行的GLS程序，无论回归元是否为外生均有效，并且其MSE接近正确设定的不可行GLS的MSE。第四，我们推导该可行GLS估计的渐近分布：在回归元为外生时，极限分布与不可行GLS估计量的极限分布相同。然而，在回归元非外生时，渐近方差中会出现一个额外项。我们提供一个无需调优参数的方差估计量，它在两种情形下都能给出渐近正确覆盖率的置信区间。我们还说明，当回归元为外生时，即使GLS基于不正确的修正，GLS也可能比OLS更稳健。主要假设为：a）回归元是预定的（与未来新息不相关）；b）误差是平稳的，从而允许以某些不可预测的新息表示Wold表示；c）误差的移动平均表示可逆，并意味着短记忆过程。我们还简要讨论与异方差误差相关的问题。
title: Feasible GLS for time series regression
title_zh: 时间序列回归的可行广义最小二乘法

abstract: This paper analyzes the effect of consumer sophistication on consumer assessment of social feedback (such as user reviews), and ultimately on a firm’s strategic decisions. Consumer sophistication is defined on a continuum of cognitive sophistication, with high levels corresponding to careful deliberation of available information and low levels corresponding to naive information processing. Consumers are aware that social feedback may be untrustworthy, and they tend to trust (distrust) positive (negative) feedback about a product for which they have a higher valuation. Optimal price, profit, and sales decrease (increase) with sophistication at low (high) levels of sophistication. Optimal sales, however, falls for a larger range of sophistication than price. At low levels of sophistication, the firm chooses to serve most consumers, and an increase in sophistication lowers the valuation of the marginal consumer, forcing the firm to cut prices. Marginal revenue also falls, lowering optimal sales. The dynamic reverses when sophistication is high, because an increase in sophistication increases the dispersion of consumer valuations. In an extension, we consider how the results change when consumers know that a firm aggressively suppresses negative feedback. Our results suggest that suppressing negative feedback harms the firm by nullifying the dispersion-enhancing effect of sophistication.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了消费者成熟度对消费者评估社会反馈（如用户评论）的影响，以及最终对企业战略决策的影响。消费者成熟度被定义在一个认知成熟度的连续统上，较高水平对应于对可获得信息的审慎思考，较低水平对应于幼稚的信息处理。消费者意识到社会反馈可能不可信，并且他们倾向于信任（不信任）关于其估值较高产品的正面（负面）反馈。在低（高）成熟度水平下，最优价格、利润和销量随成熟度下降（上升）。然而，最优销量下降所对应的成熟度范围大于价格。在低成熟度水平下，企业选择服务大多数消费者，而成熟度的提高会降低边际消费者的估值，迫使企业降价。边际收益也会下降，从而降低最优销量。当成熟度较高时，这一动态发生逆转，因为成熟度的提高会增加消费者估值的离散度。在一项扩展分析中，我们考察了当消费者知道企业积极压制负面反馈时，结果会如何变化。我们的结果表明，压制负面反馈会通过抵消成熟度的离散度增强效应而损害企业。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: Consumer sophistication and firm strategy when social feedback is untrustworthy
title_zh: 消费者成熟度与不可信社会反馈下的企业策略

abstract: The clean energy transition demands unprecedented quantities of critical minerals — lithium, cobalt, copper, and rare earth elements — with demand projected to rise six-fold by 2030, far beyond what primary mining alone can supply. Circular economy (CE) practices offer a strategic pathway to close this mineral gap while simultaneously reducing the carbon intensity of energy production. Yet despite growing scholarly interest, the empirical relationship between firm-level CE adoption and energy transition performance (ETP) remains fragmented across disciplines, with no unified framework linking these constructs at scale. This study addresses that gap through a two-phase mixed-methods design. Phase 1 delivers a PRISMA-compliant systematic literature review and bibliometric analysis of 405 synthesised articles, confirming the absence of firm-level empirical models in this nexus. Phase 2 develops and tests multi-level conceptual model grounded in Dynamic Capabilities Theory, the Natural Resource-Based View, and Institutional Theory, using structural equation modelling–partial least squares (SEM-PLS) on survey data from 318 EU energy-intensive firms, complemented by fixed-effects panel regression merging Eurostat and IEA databases. CE practices significantly predict ETP (β = 0.312, p < 0.001). This study makes three contributions: an empirically validated firm-level framework linking CE practices to ETP, which to our knowledge is the first of its kind at this scale; the introduction of critical mineral circularity as novel strategic moderator; and cross-national evidence on how policy environments condition the CE–energy transition nexus. Findings carry direct implications for corporate supply chain strategy, EU regulatory design, and achievement of SDG 7, SDG 12, and SDG 13.
abstract_zh: 清洁能源转型对关键矿产——锂、钴、铜和稀土元素——的需求达到了前所未有的规模，预计到2030年需求将增长六倍，远远超出仅靠初级采矿所能供应的水平。循环经济（CE）实践为弥合这一矿产缺口提供了一条战略路径，同时还能降低能源生产的碳强度。然而，尽管学术界兴趣日益浓厚，企业层面CE采纳与能源转型绩效（ETP）之间的实证关系仍分散于各学科之中，尚无统一框架在规模化层面将这两个构念联系起来。本研究通过两阶段混合方法设计来填补这一空白。第一阶段开展了符合PRISMA规范的系统性文献综述和对405篇综合文献的文献计量分析，证实该交叉领域中缺乏企业层面的实证模型。第二阶段基于动态能力理论、自然资源基础观和制度理论，开发并检验了一个多层次概念模型，采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（SEM-PLS）对来自318家欧盟能源密集型企业进行调查数据分析，并辅以合并Eurostat和IEA数据库的固定效应面板回归。CE实践显著预测ETP（β = 0.312，p < 0.001）。本研究作出三项贡献：一个经实证验证的、将CE实践与ETP联系起来的企业层面框架，据我们所知，这是该规模上的首个此类框架；引入关键矿产循环性作为新的战略调节变量；以及关于政策环境如何调节CE—能源转型关系的跨国证据。研究发现对企业供应链战略、欧盟监管设计以及SDG 7、SDG 12和SDG 13的实现具有直接启示。
title: Circular economy practices and clean energy transition performance: the moderating role of critical mineral circularity and policy stringency among EU energy-intensive firms
title_zh: 循环经济实践与清洁能源转型绩效：关键矿物循环性和政策严格性在欧盟能源密集型企业中的调节作用

abstract: Increased access to finance is widely viewed as a key driver to increase adaptive capacity in response to climate change. However, apart from limited studies on borrowing behavior, little is known about how exposure to extreme heat impacts microfinance clients’ financial behavior. This study addresses this gap by investigating the short-run effects of unusual heat on microfinance clients’ saving and withdrawal behavior. In a case study, it combines geo-located temperature data with a unique dataset of around 50,000 clients of a leading Microfinance Institution (MFI) in Benin. Applying two-way fixed effects, seemingly unrelated regression, and ordinary least square models, the study finds that exposure to extreme heat is heterogeneously associated with microfinance clients’ financial behavior. Specifically, non-agricultural clients show suggestive evidence for the accumulation of precautionary savings after extreme heat days in the precedent quarter, while agricultural clients statistically significantly reduce their savings following exposure to extreme heat in the precedent quarter. Microfinance clients increase their withdrawals when exposed to extreme heat within the precedent quarter, but the association is not robust to agricultural clients’ withdrawals in response to an increase in annual extreme heat days. Addressing the heterogeneous financial responses across different clients to extreme heat consequently requires explicit policy attention. Our findings contribute to a better understanding of the impact of extreme weather events on individual economic outcomes, how financial behavior relates to weather risk, and how microfinance clients respond to shocks.
abstract_zh: 增加融资渠道被广泛视为提升应对气候变化适应能力的关键驱动因素。然而，除有限的借贷行为研究外，关于极端高温暴露与小额信贷客户金融行为之间的关联，目前仍知之甚少。本研究通过考察异常高温与小额信贷客户储蓄和取款行为的短期关联，填补了这一空白。在案例研究中，本文将地理定位温度数据与贝宁一家领先小额信贷机构（MFI）约50,000名客户的独特数据集相结合。研究采用双向固定效应、似不相关回归和普通最小二乘模型，发现极端高温暴露与小额信贷客户的金融行为存在异质性关联。具体而言，非农业客户显示出在前一季度极端高温日后进行预防性储蓄积累的提示性证据，而极端高温日与农业客户的储蓄呈负相关。小额信贷客户在前一季度内暴露于极端高温时会增加取款，但对于农业客户因年度极端高温日增加而取款的反应，这一关联并不稳健。因此，应对不同客户对极端高温的异质性金融反应需要明确的政策关注。我们的发现有助于更好地理解极端高温与个体经济结果之间的关联、金融行为与天气风险的关系，以及小额信贷客户如何应对冲击。
title: When heat hits: Short-run saving and withdrawal behavior among microfinance clients in Benin
title_zh: 当热浪来袭：贝宁小额信贷客户的短期储蓄与取款行为

abstract: This paper studies residential electricity demand under Increasing Block Pricing (IBP) with intermittent billing, where cycle-level information on realized usage and billed charges becomes available only after a billing cycle ends. Using monthly billing records for 199,090 households served by the Sacramento Municipal Utility District between 2005 and 2008, I apply a sharp regression discontinuity (RD) design around the lower-tier Baseline Usage Quantity, where the marginal price rises discontinuously. The estimate indicates a reduction of 0.058 kWh/day in average daily consumption during the subsequent billing cycle, equivalent to about 0.26% of the local control-group mean. Under the RD assumptions, this estimate represents a local, cycle-averaged threshold-crossing effect near the cutoff. This ex post response coexists with the absence of sharp ex ante bunching in observed consumption, showing that the absence of sharp bunching need not imply the absence of price responsiveness under intermittent billing. The design does not distinguish among competing behavioral mechanisms, but the next-cycle timing pattern makes feedback timing a relevant consideration for nonlinear tariff design.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在阶梯定价（IBP）与间歇性账单制度下的居民电力需求，在该制度下，关于实际用电量和账单费用的周期层面信息只有在账单周期结束后才能获得。利用萨克拉门托市政公用事业区在2005年至2008年间服务的199，090户家庭的月度账单记录，我围绕较低档的基准用电量采用了尖锐断点回归（RD）设计，在该基准处边际价格出现不连续上升。估计结果表明，在随后的账单周期内，日均消费量减少了0.058千瓦时/天，约相当于当地对照组均值的0.26%。在断点回归假设下，这一估计代表了断点附近局部的、按周期平均的跨阈值效应。这种事后反应与观察到的消费中不存在明显的预先聚集现象并存，表明在间歇性账单制度下，缺乏明显的聚集并不必然意味着不存在价格反应。该设计无法区分相互竞争的行为机制，但下一周期的时点模式使反馈时点成为非线性电价设计中的一个相关考量因素。
title: No bunching, yet response: Household electricity demand under increasing block pricing with intermittent billing
title_zh: 无聚集却有响应：间歇性计费下递增阶梯定价的家庭电力需求

abstract: We study how firms choose to allocate control over strategic corporate decisions between shareholders and management in a historical setting where governance design was not mandated by corporate law, but ownership structures were constrained by differences in regional wealth distributions. The general shareholder meeting is the dominant governance body, retaining control over the largest number of strategic decisions. Nevertheless, firms with a predominance of small —and plausibly less informed— shareholders empower managers by delegating control over a larger number of strategic decisions to them. Furthermore, shareholder empowerment is accompanied by statutory provisions that facilitate information acquisition, suggesting that control and information are complements. Our findings highlight that the debate on shareholder empowerment should account for the role of ownership structure and information as key determinants of the allocation of control between shareholders and management.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在这样一个历史情境中，企业如何在股东与管理层之间分配对战略性公司决策的控制权：在该情境下，治理设计并未由公司法强制规定，但所有权结构受到区域财富分布差异的约束。股东大会是主导性的治理机构，保留了对最多战略性决策的控制权。然而，当小股东——且很可能是信息较不充分的股东——占主导时，企业会通过将更多战略性决策的控制权委托给管理层来赋予其权力。此外，股东赋权伴随着有助于信息获取的法定条款，这表明控制权与信息是互补的。我们的发现强调，关于股东赋权的讨论应考虑到所有权结构和信息的作用，它们是股东与管理层之间控制权分配的关键决定因素。
title: Shareholder empowerment and ownership structure in a free-contracting environment
title_zh: 自由缔约环境下的股东赋权与所有权结构

abstract: While globalization has significantly improved supply chain efficiency, it has also increased the exposure of firms to supply chain risks and vulnerabilities. How firms respond to these risks has therefore become an increasingly important question. Using data on Chinese listed firms from 2009 to 2023, this paper constructs a novel firm-year measure of supply chain risk perception based on textual analysis and examines how firms adjust their supplier networks in response to rising uncertainty. This expansion occurs along both domestic and international dimensions, with firms sourcing from a broader set of countries, consistent with a risk diversification strategy. Moreover, firms shift sourcing towards countries with higher government efficiency, suggesting an institutional channel through which firms enhance supply stability. Importantly, our additional evidence provides limited support for the view that the increase in supplier numbers is primarily driven by firms’ business expansion. These findings provide important implications for both firms and policymakers seeking to enhance supply chain resilience in an increasingly uncertain global environment.

title: Supply chain risk and strategic reconfiguration: evidence from China
title_zh: 供应链风险与战略重构：来自中国的证据

abstract: We introduce a probabilistic fine scheme into a simple model of a public bad with negative externalities. As the fine scheme is probabilistic, an agent’s probability to be fined depends on its relative action level. This creates an additional positive externality that could potentially restore efficiency by neutralising the negative externality from the public bad. In our analysis we derive conditions on the primitives of the model that guarantee the existence of an efficient equilibrium. We also demonstrate that a fine scheme can always be designed in such a way that an efficient outcome is induced in equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 我们将一个概率罚款机制引入到一个具有负外部性的公共坏品简单模型中。由于罚款机制是概率性的，代理人被罚款的概率取决于其相对行动水平。这产生了一种额外的正外部性，有可能通过中和公共坏品带来的负外部性来恢复效率。在分析中，我们推导了模型基本要素上的条件，以保证有效均衡的存在。我们还证明，罚款机制总是可以被设计成在均衡中诱导出有效结果。
title: Efficient probabilistic fines under negative externalities
title_zh: 负外部性下的有效概率罚款

abstract: We study a bilateral trade setting where a seller privately chooses quality, and a buyer may pay to verify it. We show that information acquisition by the buyer can give rise to an informational hold-up problem: when verification produces precise information, the seller shades quality, stripping the marginal buyer of surplus, causing trade to unravel. Trade survives only when verification is noisy enough to leave the buyer with residual surplus, yet precise enough to discipline the seller. The hold-up mechanism persists under buyer heterogeneity, noise in production, convex costs, and endogenous pricing.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个双边贸易环境，其中卖方私下选择质量，而买方可以付费验证质量。我们表明，买方的信息获取可能引发信息性套牢问题：当验证产生精确信息时，卖方会降低质量，剥夺边际买方的剩余，导致贸易瓦解。只有当验证噪声足够大，使买方保留剩余，同时又足够精确以约束卖方时，贸易才能存续。该套牢机制在买方异质性、生产噪声、凸成本以及内生定价下依然存在。
title: Buyer Verification and Endogenous Quality
title_zh: 买方验证与内生质量

abstract: We investigate the impact of rising inequality on social instability through a novel multi-period laboratory experiment. In each period, members of two groups are randomly matched to play a battle of the sexes game, in which payoffs are either zero for both or positive but unequal. At the beginning of the game, the implied payoff inequality is low but, under some treatments, it increases over time. While under low initial inequality, unequal conventions – where one group is systematically better off – tend to emerge, increasing inequality causes destabilization. This is initiated by the group disadvantaged by the unequal convention and is particularly pronounced when not only the relative, but also the absolute position of the disadvantaged group is worsening. These findings are consistent with a simple model incorporating disadvantageous inequality aversion. Finally, we show that history matters; responses to current inequality depend on past experiences of inequality and stability.
title: Does increasing inequality threaten social stability? Evidence from the lab
title_zh: 不平等加剧是否威胁社会稳定？来自实验室的证据

abstract: Crowdsourcing-based decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) often aggregate members’ information and beliefs through token-weighted voting. Existing research shows that token-weighted voting erodes information aggregation when members vote myopically, whereas strategic members adjust the weight on their private signals inversely to their token holdings to unravel the weighting mechanism. We test voters’ behavior in a controlled experiment, finding that participants vote myopically, conservatively weighting their private signals, and that the voting mechanism does not influence their propensity to act strategically. Our results provide an important first step in developing a behavioral understanding of DAOs.
title: Behavioral Tokenomics: Myopic Voting and Token-Weighted Governance
title_zh: 行为代币经济学：短视投票与代币加权治理

abstract: This paper examines how invasion-related disruption reshapes the demand for digital skills. The analysis uses a novel dataset of millions of online job vacancies in Ukraine from 2021 to 2025 classified with large language models and mapped to the ESCO taxonomy. The paper links vacancy-level skill data to high-frequency ACLED attack intensity measures and estimate time-series models. The findings document a robust positive association between attack intensity and the digital skill share of job postings, consistent across specifications and alternative attack measures. Within- and between-occupation shifts and remote work adoption jointly drive this increase, with within-occupation reskilling and upskilling alone accounting for roughly half of the total rise. The growing digital skill share partly reflects the relative resilience of digital hiring against a broader contraction in the volume of vacancies. These findings carry concrete implications for digital reskilling policy, labor market monitoring, and recovery and reconstruction planning.
title: Labor Demand for Digital Skills in Post-2022 Ukraine: Evidence from Online Job Vacancy Data
title_zh: 2022年后乌克兰数字技能的劳动力需求：来自在线职位空缺数据的证据

abstract: This paper examines the impact of bank transparency on bank efficiency. Using the 2014 information disclosure rule for listed banks issued by the China Securities Regulatory Commission as an exogenous shock, we conduct a staggered difference-in-differences analysis using data on Chinese commercial banks from 2008 to 2023. We find that improved bank transparency reduces interest expenses and the cost-to-income ratios on the cost side, while increasing loan interest income, market power, and market share on the income side, thereby enhancing bank efficiency. This positive effect is more pronounced for less efficient banks and those with lower customer deposit ratios, as well as in regions with weaker financial regulation. Transparency also lowers bank risk and liquidity hoarding, with long-lasting efficiency gains. Overall, enhancing bank transparency supports stable and high-quality banking development, with valuable implications for global banking regulation and governance.

title: When Banks Are No Longer Mysterious: Bank Transparency and Efficiency
title_zh: 当银行不再神秘：银行透明度与效率

abstract: We exploit two regulatory changes, one under US GAAP and the other under IFRS, that mandate improved disclosure of pension asset allocation. While the changes are otherwise similar, US GAAP retains the expected rate of return (“ERR”) on pension assets, which preparers can more easily manipulate if asset allocation remains opaque, while IFRS eliminates the ERR. We find that the IFRS standard improves pension asset transparency more than the US standard, which only mandates higher-quality disclosure without changing recognition or measurement and hence leaves unchanged preparers’ incentives to obfuscate. The US standard elicits a mixed response that reduces transparency in some respects. We isolate the relative deterioration in US firms’ transparency to firms with stronger incentives to inflate ERRs. Overall, our study highlights the potential for standard setters to learn from each other by comparing their regulatory experience on a specific accounting topic with clearly identifiable managerial incentives.
title: So similar, yet so different: comparing the US GAAP and IFRS experience at eliciting greater transparency on pension asset disclosures
title_zh: 如此相似，却又如此不同：比较美国GAAP与IFRS在提高养老金资产披露透明度方面的经验

abstract: We examine the long-term labor market consequences of exposure to Agent Orange during the Vietnam War, focusing on cohorts whose childhoods overlapped the spraying period. Exploiting district-level variation in herbicide exposure intensity, we find exposed individuals attain lower levels of schooling and reduce their labor supply by 7% relative to the mean. Among individuals who remain in their birth provinces, labor income is reduced by 26.7%. We show that cognitive and physical health impairments do not fully explain the effects. Exposure also reduced household income and pushed individuals toward primary industries, away from wage employment. We further document intergenerational effects, as children of exposed parents exhibit lower educational attainment and reduced labor supply. These findings highlight the lasting and multigenerational economic costs of wartime chemical exposure.
title: The unseen pain of the Vietnam War: long-term effects of Agent Orange on labor market outcomes
title_zh: 越南战争看不见的伤痛：橙剂对劳动力市场结果的长期影响

abstract: This paper presents a finite-horizon, multiperiod, dynamic model of a durable goods market where owners have private information about product quality. We model product quality as changing stochastically over time and do not require monotonic depreciation. Purchase decisions depend on the endogenous quality distributions of the different types of goods for sale. The framework allows for multiple sources of nonstationarity such as changes in obsolescence and external supply over time. The market equilibrium is defined by prices, quantities, and the quality distributions of the different types of durable goods available for purchase. We use a fixed-point method to provide a formal proof of the existence of equilibrium. We discuss the challenges of computational applications and report a numerical implementation for a stylized 20-period discrete version of the model. Because we allow equilibrium to be nonstationary and quality to change non-monotonically, our framework can be extended to the housing market, the marriage market, and other markets where unobservable quality influences the product or relationship’s value over time.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个耐用品市场的有限期、多期动态模型，其中所有者对产品质量拥有私人信息。我们将产品质量建模为随时间随机变化，且不要求其单调折旧。购买决策取决于待售不同类型商品的内生质量分布。该框架允许存在多种非平稳性来源，例如过时程度的变化以及外部供给随时间的变化。市场均衡由价格、数量以及可供购买的不同类型耐用品的质量分布来定义。我们采用不动点方法为均衡的存在性提供了正式证明。我们讨论了计算应用中的挑战，并报告了该模型一个风格化的20期离散版本的数值实现。由于我们允许均衡是非平稳的且质量可以非单调变化，我们的框架可以扩展到住房市场、婚姻市场以及其他不可观测质量会随时间影响产品或关系价值的市场。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

title: A Dynamic Model of Equilibrium with Private Information

abstract: The expansion of intermittent renewable electricity increases supply variability and requires greater flexibility from consumers. This results in welfare losses for agents who are averse to fluctuations. Our model analyzes these welfare consequences by considering short-term and exogenous variability in renewable energy generation. We explore an optimal control problem that determines a welfare-maximizing electricity consumption path by controlling dispatchable energy and storage. This optimization problem identifies three scenarios: no active storage, abundant storage capacities and limited capacities. We then derive an overall consumer welfare function for alternative energy mixes. This allows us to assess the welfare effects of changing the energy mix. In particular, we consider the substitution of dispatchable fossil-fueled energy generation by renewable energy.
abstract_zh: 间歇性可再生电力的扩张增加了供给的可变性，并要求消费者具备更大的灵活性。这给厌恶波动的行为主体带来了福利损失。我们的模型通过考虑可再生能源发电的短期和外生可变性来分析这些福利后果。我们探讨了一个最优控制问题，通过控制可调度能源和储能来确定福利最大化的电力消费路径。该优化问题识别出三种情景：无主动储能、储能容量充裕以及容量有限。随后，我们为不同能源组合推导出一个总体消费者福利函数。这使我们能够评估改变能源组合的福利效应。特别地，我们考虑了以可再生能源替代可调度化石燃料发电的情形。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

title: Optimal electricity consumption and storage under short-term renewable supply variability
title_zh: 短期可再生能源供应波动下的最优电力消费与储存

abstract: The AI boom is usually discussed as a contest over models, chips, and productivity. This column argues that it is also a large physical infrastructure and credit cycle. The policy priority is not to call the peak, but to measure who owns the assets, who owes the debt, and where contingent obligations will land if demand disappoints.
abstract_zh: 人工智能热潮通常被讨论为一场围绕模型、芯片和生产率的竞赛。本专栏认为，它同时也是一场规模庞大的实体基础设施与信贷周期。政策优先事项不是判断峰值何时到来，而是衡量谁拥有这些资产、谁背负债务，以及如果需求令人失望，或有负债将落在何处。
title: Financing the AI buildout before the risks go off balance sheet
title_zh: 在为风险转出资产负债表之前为人工智能建设融资

abstract: High public debt in several euro-area countries has renewed the debate over a central question: can fiscal pressures in one member state affect inflation expectations elsewhere by constraining the ECB? This column uses a randomised information experiment with German firms to show that the answer depends on trust in the central bank. Pessimistic debt projections for France, Italy, and Spain raise the three-year inflation expectations of firms that distrust the ECB, while high-trust firms do not react. By contrast, a €500 billion German debt package leaves inflation expectations unchanged.
abstract_zh: 几个欧元区国家的高公共债务重新引发了对一个核心问题的辩论：一个成员国的财政压力能否通过约束欧洲央行来影响其他地区的通胀预期？本专栏利用一项针对德国企业的随机信息实验表明，答案取决于对中央银行的信任。对法国、意大利和西班牙的悲观债务预测，会提高那些不信任欧洲央行的企业的三年期通胀预期，而高信任度的企业则没有反应。相比之下，一项5000亿欧元的德国债务计划并未使通胀预期发生变化。
authors: Francesco Bianchi, Renato Faccini, Leonardo Melosi, Nils Wehrhöfer
title: Your debt, my inflation: The role of trust in the ECB
title_zh: 你的债务，我的通胀：信任在欧洲央行中的作用

abstract: Against the background of rising supply chain vulnerability and accelerating digital transformation, understanding how enterprises utilize artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance supply chain resilience (SCR) is of great practical significance. However, the extent to which AI effectively enhances SCR remains an empirical question. Drawing on panel data from Chinese A-share listed firms from 2012 to 2024, this study investigates the impact of AI adoption on SCR and elucidates its underlying mechanisms from the dual perspectives of capability development and external resource diversity. The results show that AI significantly enhances SCR, particularly for maturity-stage firms, state-owned enterprises (SOEs), companies located in Eastern China, and firms with weak supplier-side market power but strong client-side market power. Mechanism analysis reveals that AI achieves this by improving organizational agility, optimizing supply-demand matching, and promoting supply chain diversification. These findings underscore the role of AI as a key driver of SCR, offering robust empirical evidence and practical guidance for building AI-enabled, resilient supply chains that support sustainable economic development.

title: How Does Artificial Intelligence enhance supply chain resilience? Evidence from China
